name: Hypothetical Modality Framing
narrative:
CARDIOLOGY CONSULTATION
Patient evaluated for palpitations.
ASSESSMENT & PLAN: Consider implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) if sustained ventricular tachycardia develops in the future. Echocardiogram shows LVEF 42%. Currently stable on low dose carvedilol.
rationale: Evidence for ICD is phrased hypothetically ('consider... if... develops') and LVEF is 42% (fails <=35%).

name: Negated Clinical Condition
narrative:
ANNUAL WELLNESS EXAM
CARDIAC EVALUATION:
Patient denies heart failure symptoms. No evidence of left ventricular ejection fraction reduction. LVEF is 55% on recent screening study. Negative for ischemic cardiomyopathy. No GDMT indicated.
rationale: Key conditions are explicitly negated ('denies', 'no evidence of', 'negative for') and LVEF is normal.

name: Future-Planned Timeline Precondition
narrative:
ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY CLINIC
Patient with newly diagnosed non-ischemic cardiomyopathy. Echo confirms LVEF 30%.
PLAN: Patient is scheduled for elective CRT-D implantation next month. GDMT initiated 12 days ago with lisinopril 5mg and carvedilol 6.25mg.
rationale: Procedure is future-planned and GDMT duration (12 days) fails mandatory 90-day statutory trial.

name: Wrong Subject / Family History Attribution
narrative:
PRE-OPERATIVE CLINIC
CHIEF COMPLAINT: Evaluation for cardiac clearance.
FAMILY HISTORY: Notable for severe symptomatic aortic stenosis in father requiring urgent surgical valve replacement. Mother had severe mitral regurgitation requiring MitraClip.
PATIENT STATUS: Patient reports excellent exercise tolerance, walking 3 miles daily without dyspnea. Echocardiogram confirms normal mitral valve and normal aortic valve area.
rationale: Valvular indications exist solely in family history; patient has normal valves and no clinical symptoms.

name: Contradictory Hemodynamic Measurements Across Sections
narrative:
INPATIENT CARDIOLOGY SUMMARY
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
Initial point-of-care ultrasound on admission 10/02/2026 documented severe systolic dysfunction with LVEF 22%.
DIAGNOSTIC STUDIES:
Formal comprehensive transthoracic echocardiogram performed on 10/14/2026 shows completely normal global systolic function with LVEF 56%.
PLAN: Reconcile discordant echo findings prior to any invasive intervention.
rationale: Sharp clinical contradiction between LVEF 22% and LVEF 56% requires clinician reconciliation.

name: Numeric Value Out of Range
narrative:
CARDIOLOGY PROGRESS NOTE
CLINICAL SUMMARY:
Patient with coronary artery disease and NYHA Class II symptoms on stable GDMT for 1 year.
Echocardiogram: Left ventricular ejection fraction measured at LVEF 46%.
Impression: Mild systolic dysfunction; does not meet device threshold.

name: Negated Comorbidities for Mild-Moderate Range
narrative:
SLEEP MEDICINE CONSULTATION
DIAGNOSTIC POLYSOMNOGRAPHY:
Overnight sleep study demonstrates mild-to-moderate obstructive sleep apnea with AHI 9.4 events/hr.
REVIEW OF SYSTEMS:
Patient denies daytime sleepiness. Blood pressure normal without medications, no hypertension. No history of stroke or ischemic heart disease.
rationale: AHI is 9.4 (band 5-14 requires documented comorbidity); all qualifying comorbidities are explicitly negated.

name: Conditional Speculative Framing
narrative:
VASCULAR SURGERY CLINIC
ASSESSMENT: Patient with asymptomatic carotid bruit.
PLAN: If patient should develop neurological symptoms or TIA, consider carotid artery stenting (CAS). Carotid duplex ultrasound reveals mild carotid stenosis of 35% on the left and 40% on the right.
rationale: CAS is mentioned conditionally ('if patient should develop...'), and stenosis 35-40% fails statutory asymptomatic threshold of >= 70%.
